observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructors teach as a pair with an upbeat and friendly tone, alternating explanations for leaders and followers. They break down footwork step-by-step and emphasize body positioning and posture.

lesson_structure.note: Brian B and Miss Megan introduce themselves and outline the 7 foxtrot moves.
Demonstration of the moves with music.
Breakdown of the basic foxtrot footwork for leaders and followers.
Explanation of frame and upper body connection in closed position.
Introduction and breakdown of the promenade basic.
Introduction and breakdown of the promenade with an underarm turn.

metaphors: if Megan was shaped like a box
common_mistakes: turning our shoulders instead of using hand pressure
safety: not stepping on each other's feet

steps_taught.name: Foxtrot Basic
steps_taught.description: Two walking steps forward/back followed by a side step together.

steps_taught.name: Promenade Basic
steps_taught.description: Moving along the line of dance with shoulders and frame facing partner while nose and toes travel.

steps_taught.name: Promenade with an Underarm Turn
steps_taught.description: Promenade basic incorporating an underarm turn for the follower.

what_works: separate footwork explanations for leaders and followers
clear visual demonstrations from different angles

quotes.text: we're here to help you build confidence so you can look great on the dance floor
leaders are always going to start with their left foot followers or ladies are going to start with their right
lay your arm down on the leaders but not lean

evidence_segments.observation: Couple dancing basic foxtrot side by side to camera view in dance studio.
Leader demonstrates footwork solo, stepping forward and to the side.
Couple demonstrates ballroom hold frame facing camera.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the upper body frame by visualizing a box around the follower and comparing hand placement to a towel bar.
